# #310 — Spool auto-drain skips (and repeatedly re-fails) units parked under a different project scope

State: CLOSED
Author: rodaddy
Labels: none
Created: 2026-07-21T04:03:26Z
Updated: 2026-07-22T00:16:43Z
Closed: 2026-07-22T00:08:55Z

---

Found during the #307 rollout validation on core01 and local (0.1.10).

`FirstClassMemoryRuntime._drain_spool` replays every pending unit through the runtime's router, whose exact-scope proof (#294) validates `session_start` results against the **current runtime scope**. A unit parked under project A (e.g. `session_key dev:open-brain`) therefore fails dispatch with `session_start result did not prove exact Open Brain scope: channel_id, session_key` when the drain is triggered by a healthy operation in project B (`dev:Development`), and the unit is retained.

Observed:
- core01: 5 parked `open-brain` groups survived multiple healthy `Development`-scoped captures; drained instantly (10 lines → 0) once a capture ran with an `open-brain` cwd.
- local: 25 parked `rtech-agents` session_start/session_wrap groups (from the stranded sessions in development#39) plus 2 `Development` groups only drained when scope-matched captures were issued per project.

Consequences (no data loss, records stay parked):
1. Units can sit undelivered indefinitely if the client rarely operates in that project again.
2. Every drain attempt re-dispatches mismatched units, issuing a wasted live `session_start` per unit per healthy operation, plus a swallowed warning.

Proposed direction: make the drain scope-aware — either dispatch each record through a router/scope derived from the record's own payload (payloads already carry agent/platform/channel_id/server_id/session_key), or filter replay to units whose scope matches the current runtime and leave the rest untouched without dispatching them.

Repro receipts and traceback captured 2026-07-21 during the 0.1.10 rollout.
